executor_constraints: Keep both existing git ls-tree HEAD pathspecs, phase-1 accounting, phase-2 checks, phase-3 eligibility/counting, per-path warning, rc mapping and call sites semantically unchanged.
Render the required-path line from REQUIRED_FLEET_PATHS with Bash-3.2-safe guarded expansion and print (none) when empty.
Use copyGateFile so the test executes the live working-tree verifier bytes by default.

All repositories, HOME directories, required-array edits and production-wording mutations must live under synthetic temporary roots; never mutate the real fleet, HOME, frozen driver or planner/executor source worktree for a drill.
Use local synthetic Git identity, disable hooks/signing/system/global Git configuration, clear inherited Git redirection variables, CI and AILANG_BIN, and bound fixture subprocesses to 10 seconds.
Capture mutation verdicts without pipelines; a command rc=0 is expected for the reverted script and the test must fail on the independent disclosure assertion.

Before the drill capture exact bytes and SHA-256 for scripts/verify_go.sh and host/verifygate/driver_fleet_scope_gate_test.go; restore from those captured bytes, never from HEAD, and verify both hashes before rerunning green.
Do not interpret the inherited verify_go rc=1 as a sprint failure and do not claim a full-green verifier.
